'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Five [[Border Guard Command (Iran)|Iranian border guard]]s are killed and two others are injured in [[Saravan, Iran|Saravan]], [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], during a confrontation with an [[Violent non-state actor|armed group]] at [[Iran–Pakistan border|the border]] with [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-border-clash-guards-killed-pakistan-7c871b8b66363155d1b8acdd8d211acb (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two people are killed when an [[MD Helicopters MD 530|MD-530 helicopter]] crashes into [[power line]]s in [[Samangan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-Taliban-helicopter-crash-crewmembers-killed-4982dc5ee3880b6cfbc3102e1463da90 (AP)]
*Two pilots are killed when a private [[DHC-6 Twin Otter]] crashes {{conv|54|km|mi}} off the coast of [[California]], [[United States]]. The [[NTSB]] is investigating the accident. [https://www.ktvu.com/news/plane-crashes-near-half-moon-bay (KTVU-TV)] [https://www.sfchronicle.com/california/article/half-moon-bay-plane-crash-18110645.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
*A massive fire damages the [[Manila Central Post Office]] in [[Manila]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.cnnphilippines.com/news/2023/5/22/Manila-Central-Post-Office-fire.html (CNN Philippines)] [https://www.rappler.com/nation/fire-manila-central-post-office-may-2023/ (Rappler)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are killed in a shooting in the [[11th arrondissement of Marseille|11th arrondissement]] of [[Marseille]], [[France]]. The suspects are still at large. [https://www.bfmtv.com/marseille/marseille-trois-morts-dans-une-fusillade-devant-une-boite-de-nuit-les-suspects-en-fuite_AN-202305210072.html (BFMTV)]
*Members of the [[Letzte Generation|Last Generation]] activist group pour [[charcoal]] into the [[Trevi Fountain]] in [[Rome]], [[Italy]], turning the water black. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/may/21/rome-climate-protesters-turn-trevi-fountain-water-black (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Tajikistan]] announces the [[repatriation]] from [[Syria]] of 104 partners and children of [[jihadist]]s. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/middle-east/iran-eastern-states/1684755442-tajikistan-repatriates-104-women-and-children-of-jihadi-terrorists-from-syria (i24NEWS)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 East Timorese parliamentary election]]
**Citizens in [[East Timor]] head to [[Polling station|the polls]] to elect the 65 members of the [[National Parliament (East Timor)|National Parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/east-timor-heads-polls-parliamentary-election-2023-05-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[May 2023 Greek legislative election]]
**[[Greeks]] head to [[Polling station|the polls]] to elect the 300 members of [[Hellenic Parliament|parliament]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-elections-vote-financial-crisis-economy-4a7b298f49e34031342d03128e1a81c7 (AP)]
*[[Moldovan protests (2022–present)|Moldovan protests]]
**More than 75,000 people gather in [[Chișinău]] to [[political demonstration|demonstrate]] in favor of [[Moldova]] joining the [[European Union|EU]], following a call for a rally by [[President of Moldova|President]] [[Maia Sandu]] in order to outdo anti-[[government of Moldova|government]] and pro-Russian demonstrations organized by the opposition. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/5/21/pro-government-rally-in-moldovan-capital-draws-tens-of-thousands (Al Jazeera)]
